subject.title: feat(session): add named new and close chat commands

question: Should OpenClaw core expose `/close` and `/delete` as chat commands that archive/delete the current non-main session, and should named `/new` continue writing the legacy `label` field while title migration work is open?
rationale: The parser bug is mechanically fixable, but accepting a destructive chat command and choosing the label/title contract are product/session-state decisions tied to related session-management PRs.

options.title: Fix parser, then review feature
options.body: Repair native model fallthrough first, keep the PR open, and let maintainers decide the command surface after fresh proof.

options.title: Defer until title migration lands
options.body: Pause this PR until canonical title-vs-label work settles, reducing the chance of shipping a transient naming contract.

options.title: Drop destructive commands
options.body: Keep only named `/new` in this branch and leave chat-side close/delete to a separate session-management decision.

recommendation.title: Fix parser, then review feature
recommendation.body: Repair native model fallthrough first, keep the PR open, and let maintainers decide the command surface after fresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session delete/control and gateway session-management commits make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the product-surface decision.
